name: Swinging Price Tag
blurb: A luxury cardboard price tag swings on a string in a spotlight over a blurred B-roll backdrop; problem lines write the retail price and brand on it; on the turn a red marker slashes the price and the tag flips to the DHgate side with '??'; key words hang off the string as smaller tags; the tag lands on the title.
off_why: ultimate dhgate free reselling spreadsheet 2026-10-23: 'too boring, nothing is really moving, this template is a little iffy, there's no clips'. The B-roll sits blurred behind a big tag, and the tag showed a made-up $1,500 retail price.
